description: 40 business questions over the enterprise demo schema, executed against a real MySQL instance. Gold SQL and model SQL run on the same read-only database; data is synthetic enterprise demo data.

cases.question: 统计各区域已完成订单的销售总额，按金额从高到低排序
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_sales FROM enterprise_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC, region ASC

cases.question: 2025 年每个月的订单总金额是多少，按月升序
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total FROM enterprise_orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY month ASC

cases.question: 各销售渠道的订单数和平均订单金额分别是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM enterprise_orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel ASC

cases.question: 每个客户等级各有多少客户
cases.gold_sql: SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_customers GROUP BY level ORDER BY level ASC

cases.question: 互联网行业客户的订单总金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total FROM enterprise_orders o JOIN enterprise_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.industry = '互联网'

cases.question: 各订单区域的订单取消率分别是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancel_rate FROM enterprise_orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 2025 年第一季度的订单总金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total FROM enterprise_orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-04-01'

cases.question: 各订单区域已完成订单的客单价是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM enterprise_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 订单金额超过 10000 的订单在各订单区域分别有多少单
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders WHERE total_amount > 10000 GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 各支付方式已支付的金额合计是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT method, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS paid_total FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY method ORDER BY method ASC

cases.question: 各订单区域的待回款金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS pending_total FROM payments p JOIN enterprise_orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'pending' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region ASC

cases.question: 各支付方式的退款金额占比是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT method, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount), 4) AS refund_ratio FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY method ASC

cases.question: 每种支付状态各有多少笔支付
cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC

cases.question: 各行业分别有多少客户
cases.gold_sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_customers GROUP BY industry ORDER BY industry ASC

cases.question: 信用额度最高的 10 个客户是谁
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, credit_limit FROM enterprise_customers ORDER BY credit_limit DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 2025 年各行业新签约了多少客户
cases.gold_sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY industry ORDER BY industry ASC

cases.question: 各区域客户的平均信用额度是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(credit_limit), 2) AS avg_credit FROM enterprise_customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 有多少个产品和仓库的组合库存低于补货点
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM inventory WHERE available_qty < reorder_point

cases.question: 各仓库的平均可用库存是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, ROUND(AVG(available_qty), 2) AS avg_available FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY warehouse ASC

cases.question: 各仓库距离补货点的库存缺口总量是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, SUM(reorder_point - available_qty) AS quantity_gap FROM inventory WHERE available_qty < reorder_point GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY warehouse ASC

cases.question: 每个商品类别各有多少个商品
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC

cases.question: 售价高于成本两倍的商品有多少个
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE list_price > cost * 2

cases.question: 各仓库有多少个商品已经零库存
cases.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, COUNT(*) AS stockout_count FROM inventory WHERE available_qty = 0 GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY warehouse ASC

cases.question: 办公设备类商品的平均售价是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE category = '办公设备'

cases.question: 各部门有多少人，月度人力成本合计是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS headcount, ROUND(SUM(monthly_cost), 2) AS total_cost FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY department ASC

cases.question: 各区域员工的平均月薪是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(monthly_cost), 2) AS avg_cost FROM employees GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 评分最高的 5 家供应商是谁
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name, rating FROM suppliers ORDER BY rating DESC, name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 各区域有多少家活跃供应商
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM suppliers WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC

cases.question: 各商品类别在订单明细中的总金额是多少（不区分订单状态）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_amount), 2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category ASC

cases.question: 各订单区域卖出的商品件数是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN enterprise_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region ASC

cases.question: 各行业客户的平均订单金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.industry, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM enterprise_orders o JOIN enterprise_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.industry ORDER BY c.industry ASC

cases.question: 有多少个订单完全没有支付记录
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.id IS NULL

cases.question: 各订单区域的订单数和支付笔数分别是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, COUNT(p.id) AS payment_count FROM enterprise_orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region ASC

cases.question: 2025 年每个月新增了多少客户
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(signup_date) ORDER BY month ASC

cases.question: 各客户等级的人均订单数是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(COUNT(o.id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 2) AS orders_per_customer FROM enterprise_customers c LEFT JOIN enterprise_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY c.level ASC

cases.question: 已完成订单中，各支付方式的平均支付金额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.method, ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_paid FROM payments p JOIN enterprise_orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY p.method ASC

cases.question: 用公共表表达式统计每个客户的累计完成订单金额，列出超过 50000 的前 20 个客户
cases.gold_sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total FROM enterprise_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, ROUND(total, 2) AS total FROM order_totals WHERE total > 50000 ORDER BY total DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 20

cases.question: 先按订单汇总已支付金额，再统计各订单区域的已支付总额
cases.gold_sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(p.paid_amount), 2) AS paid_total FROM enterprise_orders o JOIN paid p ON o.id = p.order_id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region ASC

cases.question: 各订单区域有多少笔退款支付
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, COUNT(*) AS refunded_count FROM payments p JOIN enterprise_orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'refunded' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region ASC

cases.question: 按累计订单金额找出前 10 个客户，并显示各自的订单数
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total FROM enterprise_customers c JOIN enterprise_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 10
